observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== web env inside container ===" && docker compose exec -T web printenv 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'DATABASE_URI|PAYLOAD_SECRET|NEXT_PUBLIC_(SERVER|APP|PUBLIC|HOCUSPOCUS)|SMTP_HOST' | sed -E 's/(SECRET=).*/\1***/' ; echo "=== docker stats ===" && docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} {{.CPUPerc}} {{.MemUsage}}' 2>&1
